verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is dlt's documented incremental loading, which loads only new or changed records rather than reloading old ones. That implies state carried between runs, so a re-run need not start from scratch, but it is not explicitly a resume-from-checkpoint mechanism for interrupted syncs. Nothing in the pack documents automatic retries for transient failures; monitoring only covers diagnosing failures after they happen. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry/backoff for transient errors, explicit resume of interrupted loads from checkpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
